PGmc n-stem < *ḱas-on-; Skt śaśá-, Khot. saha-, Pashto soe < *ḱes-o-/*ḱas-o-; Lat. cānus, OPr. sasins < *ḱas-no-; W ceinach < *ḱas-n-ih₂-
PIE *ḱas- (or *ḱh₂es-) 'grey, hare'; cognates Skt śaśá-, OPr. sasins, Lat. cānus
śaśá- m. 'hare' (RV+), by assimilation from Indo-Aryan *śasá-

*mus- 'fly; gnat, midge, mosquito' with Lat. musca, Lith. musė, OCS mъšica, Gk muîa, Arm. mun

notes: OHG hasan 'mat, dull' (de Vaan: 'grey, shining'); same -no- suffix as Lat. cānus (Kroonen)

*kólsos 'neck' (Lat. collus, OHG hals; MIr. coll 'head, chief')
